boot_script_ascii:
# bootflow scan    script bootmethod                                        .
# UART              source                                     mmc 0                          .
if test -z "${devtype}"; then
    setenv devtype mmc
fi
if test "${devtype}" != "mmc"; then
    echo Xenova Xen boot requires an MMC boot device
    exit 1
fi
if test -z "${devnum}"; then
    setenv devnum 0
fi
echo Boot Xenova Xen from ${devtype} ${devnum}

# U-Boot                 Control FDT                                                 .
if test -z "${fdtcontroladdr}" || test -z "${fdt_addr_r}"; then
    echo Missing Control FDT or working FDT address
    exit 1
fi
fdt move ${fdtcontroladdr} ${fdt_addr_r} || exit 1
fdt addr ${fdt_addr_r} || exit 1
fdt resize 0x1000 || exit 1

# Pi 4 Xen dom0           SDIO DMA                                          PIO                .
# SD                     DMA             , Control FDT                          .
fdt rm /soc/mmcnr@7e300000 dmas || exit 1
fdt rm /soc/mmcnr@7e300000 dma-names || exit 1

# Set module load addresses (                          ).
setenv xen_loadaddr     "0x00200000"
setenv kernel_loadaddr  "0x00400000"

echo Add boot arguments for Xen
fdt set /chosen xen,xen-bootargs "console=dtuart dtuart=/soc/serial@7e215040 dom0_mem='1024M' sync_console bootscrub=0" || exit 1

echo Add a dom0 node to chosen to put Linux boot information in
fdt mknode /chosen dom0 || exit 1
fdt set /chosen/dom0 compatible "multiboot,module" || exit 1

#        Pi 4 PCI/USB workaround    Xen                              .
fdt set /scb/pcie@7d500000 device_type "pci" || exit 1
fdt rm /scb/pcie@7d500000/pci@1,0/usb@1,0

echo Delay to allow the MMC card to be ready
sleep 1

#                     FAT 1    / rootfs 2                                    .
part uuid mmc ${devnum}:2 rootfs_partuuid || exit 1

echo Add boot arguments for dom0
# U-Boot       setenv xenova_debug 1                                                     .
if test "${xenova_debug}" = "1"; then
    setenv xenova_logargs "earlycon=xenboot debug loglevel=7 systemd.log_level=debug systemd.log_target=console systemd.show_status=yes"
else
    # KERN_ERR(3)                          .                  dmesg/journal                   .
    setenv xenova_logargs "loglevel=4 systemd.log_level=info systemd.log_target=journal-or-kmsg systemd.show_status=error"
fi
setenv dom0_bootargs "console=hvc0 ${xenova_logargs} root=PARTUUID=${rootfs_partuuid} rootwait"
fdt set /chosen xen,dom0-bootargs "${dom0_bootargs}" || exit 1

echo Load Xen into memory
fatload mmc ${devnum}:1 ${xen_loadaddr} xen || exit 1
echo Xen loaded, size: 0x$filesize

echo Load Linux kernel into memory
fatload mmc ${devnum}:1 ${kernel_loadaddr} Image || exit 1
setenv kernel_size 0x$filesize
echo Linux loaded, size: 0x$filesize

fdt set /chosen/dom0 reg <${kernel_loadaddr} ${kernel_size}> || exit 1
fdt set /chosen '#size-cells' <1> || exit 1
fdt set /chosen '#address-cells' <1> || exit 1
# chosen              firmware                     seed          .                                                        .
if test "${xenova_debug}" = "1"; then
    fdt print /chosen xen,xen-bootargs
    fdt print /chosen xen,dom0-bootargs
fi

echo Boot Xen
booti ${xen_loadaddr} - ${fdt_addr_r}
